subject: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — scheduling & trial plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@finlytics.com>, Ravi Sharma <ravi.sharma@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — scheduling & trial plan

Hi Dana / Ravi,

Great to connect today — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery: Finlytics wants a low-latency, compliant inference flow for document summarization and entity extraction across large customer transcripts. Primary success criteria we heard:
- Latency under 250ms p50 for 512 tokens
- Extraction precision >= 92% on your benchmark prompts
- End-to-end throughput to support 30 req/s peak

Next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff where we align on the trial plan, success criteria, sample prompt set, and access needed for a short hosted trial. Proposed 60-minute windows:
- Wed, Mar 3 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, Mar 4 — 13:00–14:00 PT

Can you confirm which works and who from your side should join (SRE, procurement, data owner)? I’ve attached a draft trial plan and a prompt-set template to help prep.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our Solutions/CS folks once we confirm a time.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
Attachment(s): trial_plan_v1.pdf, Finlytics_MVP_prompt_set.xlsx

From: Dana Li <dana.li@finlytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Sharma <ravi.sharma@finlytics.com>, Kate Patterson <kate.procure@finlytics.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — scheduling & trial plan

Connor — thanks for the recap and the materials. We’re excited to move forward. Mar 3 at 10:00 PT works for us on the product side. Please add our SRE (Ravi) and procurement (Kate) — they’ll need to be on the initial call to sign off on any trial terms.

A couple quick asks before the kickoff:
- Can you share a brief agenda (high level) and estimated time for the technical deep dive vs. business success criteria?
- Will we need to provide any sample data ahead of time or can we use the sample prompts in your template?

If you need anything from procurement up front, loop Kate in and she’ll advise.

Best,
Dana Li
Head of Product, Finlytics
dana.li@finlytics.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@finlytics.com>, Ravi Sharma <ravi.sharma@finlytics.com>, Kate Patterson <kate.procure@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — scheduling & trial plan

Thanks Dana — confirmed: Wed, Mar 3, 10:00–11:00 PT. I’ll send the calendar invite once you confirm attendees below.

Proposed 60-minute agenda (can trim):
1) 10m — Introductions & success criteria alignment (Connor / Dana)
2) 20m — Technical deep dive: runtime, quantization options, infra requirements (Neha / Ravi)
3) 15m — Trial plan walkthrough: prompt sets, eval harness, metrics to capture (Marissa)
4) 10m — Ops & procurement: access, contract, timeline (Connor / Kate)
5) 5m — Action items / next steps

Success criteria (draft):
- p50 latency <= 250ms for 512 tokens on dedicated T4 pool
- Extraction precision >= 92% on provided prompt set
- Trial throughput sustained at 30 req/s for a 1-hour soak test

Pre-kickoff deliverables from us: agenda + calendar invite, trial plan PDF, prompt template (attached earlier), HubSpot deal link. From your side: sample prompts or a small redacted data sample if you want us to run quick baseline tests during the kickoff.

HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/FIN-3487
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finlytics-eval-kickoff-20260303

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): trial_plan_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@finlytics.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ravi Sharma <ravi.sharma@finlytics.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — scheduling & trial plan

Hi all — thanks, Connor. I’ll run the eval plan portion and coordinate the prompt/eval harness. For the technical deep dive, Neha will cover runtime, kernel/quantization choices, and infra requirements.

For the kickoff please have the following Finlytics attendees if possible:
- Product owner (Dana)
- SRE/infra (Ravi)
- Data owner or engineer who will share prompt examples
- Procurement (Kate) — just for intake

If you can share 5–10 example prompts (redacted) before the call that would help us prepare a short baseline run and demo. Otherwise we’ll use the template Connor attached.





















– Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): none

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Sharma <ravi.sharma@finlytics.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Li <dana.li@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — scheduling & trial plan

Quick tech checklist from our side:
- For a hosted trial we’ll need a sample of the prompt set (5–10 examples) and an anonymized sample of your transcript data if you want realistic extraction results. If data can’t be shared, we’ll use your redacted prompts and our synthetic data.
- Network: allow outbound to our runtime endpoint and provide any IP allowlist if you plan to run in VPC mode.
- Infra doc attached with minimal VM/GPU guidance; for the initial hosted trial no infra changes required.

I’m available on Wed Mar 3 at 10am PT and can stay for the deep dive. I’ll bring a short checklist and a test run plan we can execute during the call.

Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): infra_requirements.docx

From: Dana Li <dana.li@finlytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Sharma <ravi.sharma@finlytics.com>, Kate Patterson <kate.procure@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — scheduling & trial plan

All set — Mar 3, 10:00 PT confirmed. Attendees: Dana (product), Ravi (SRE), Kate (procurement), and I’ll try to include our data engineer. Please send the calendar invite and a DocuSign link for the trial agreement we discussed so procurement can review.

Thanks — see you on Wednesday.

Dana
